hero.tagline: A small team of industry veterans, making cool games for players.

goInsane.title: Go Insane TM
goInsane.artAlt: Go Insane TM key art: two armored survivors on a cliff, facing a horde of giant insects under a burning sky.
goInsane.pitch: Fight escalating hordes in first person, then bet your run on the route.
goInsane.description: Between fights you pick your next stop on a branching map, and every step raises Threat, the one number that makes enemies tougher, spawns faster and prices higher. Greed against the clock.

facts.coop: Online co-op for 2–4 players in development

forPlayers.title: Made for players
forPlayers.description: We build the games we want to play, and we judge every decision by whether it's more fun to play.

smallOnPurpose.title: Small on purpose
smallOnPurpose.description: A small team means short paths. The people with the idea are the people building it.

veteranKnowHow.title: Veteran know-how, indie freedom
veteranKnowHow.description: Years in the industry taught us how games get made. Now we decide which ones.

studio.title: Small team. Cool games.
studio.description: fritzingcoolgames is a small indie studio of industry veterans. We started in 2025 with one goal: make cool games for players. Go Insane TM is the first, and there are more to come.
studio.artAlt: The fritzingcoolgames mascot: a cracked, glowing rock planet with two orange eyes, ringed by cyan and orange energy.

follow.title: Follow what we're making
follow.description: Wishlist our games and follow along as they come together.
